newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica trade minister Erwin to visit Japan, Korea.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica trade minister Erwin to visit Japan, Korea.

text.p: South African trade and industry minister Alec Erwin will lead an investment delegation to Japan and South Korea from October 7 to 15, the trade and industry department said in a statement on Wednesday.
The delegation will hold seminars in Tokyo and Seoul to market investment opportunities in South African automotive components, chemical, iron and steel and electronics sectors, the department said.

The department said it would undertake to facilitate working group discussions between South African and overseas represetnatives from each of the sectors involved, in addition to arranging one-on-one business meetings for individual delegates.
